title: The Code of Theseus: Can Agents Rebuild Software from Recovered Design Documents?
title_zh: 忒修斯之代码：智能体能否依据恢复出的设计文档重建软件？

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种框架，让智能体根据恢复的设计文档重建软件，并通过实验验证了这种方法的效果。 LLM agents increasingly design a system before implementing it, yet the data to train and evaluate them centres on implementation and testing: requirements and design artefacts are often missing, outdated or private. Source code, in contrast, is abundant. Prior work recovers architecture documentation by feeding LLMs the source code or letting agents explore it, which saturates the context, does not scale to many repositories, and yields a single artefact rather than aligned ones. We present a framework that recovers aligned stakeholder intent, requirements and architecture from a compact repository representation, a static dependency graph and key contextual files, and release the artefacts of 10,764 Java, Python, C/C++ and C# repositories as a dataset. An LLM judge rates the artefacts of three generators as clear and internally consistent, but less reliably correct and at the right level of abstraction. To test whether the artefacts carry the design, we pose a software Ship of Theseus: a coding agent rebuilds 29 Commit0 libraries from the intent alone or with the recovered requirements and architecture, given only an interface contract and part of the tests. The artefacts do not significantly change the held-out pass rate (33.7% vs. 35.8%), but bring the rebuilt module structure significantly closer to the original (module F1 from 0.54 to 0.63), with either generator and even with concise artefacts. Recovered artefacts thus convey design that tests do not capture, offering a scalable source of design-level data for agents that design before they implement, and the round trip measures this without human references.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种框架，让智能体根据恢复的设计文档重建软件，并通过实验验证了这种方法的效果。大语言模型智能体日益倾向于在实现系统之前先进行设计，然而用于训练和评估它们的数据却集中在实现与测试上：需求与设计工件往往缺失、过时或不公开。 相比之下，源代码却十分充足。 已有工作通过将源代码输入大语言模型或让智能体探索源代码来恢复架构文档，这会耗尽上下文、难以扩展到大量仓库，并且只能产出单一工件而非彼此对齐的工件集。 我们提出了一个框架，从紧凑的仓库表示、静态依赖图和关键上下文文件中恢复对齐的利益相关者意图、需求与架构，并发布了 10,764 个 Java、Python、C/C++ 和 C# 仓库的工件作为数据集。 一个由大语言模型担任的评判者认为三个生成器产出的工件清晰且内部一致，但在正确性和抽象层次的恰当性上则不那么可靠。 为了检验这些工件是否承载了设计，我们提出了一个软件版的忒修斯之船实验：一个编码智能体仅凭意图、或结合恢复的需求与架构，在只给定接口契约和部分测试的条件下，重建 29 个 Commit0 库。 这些工件并未显著改变留出集上的通过率（33.7% 对 35.8%），但使重建出的模块结构显著更接近原始结构（模块 F1 从 0.54 提升到 0.63），且无论使用哪个生成器、甚至使用精简工件时均如此。 因此，恢复的工件传达了测试无法捕捉的设计，为那些先设计后实现的智能体提供了可扩展的设计级数据来源，而这一往返过程无需人工参照即可对其进行度量。
